functional.summary: Functional check of the /permissions surfaces through the tap-budget harness (S5) and the four provider suites on the committed T5b tree: the DM list renders the mode line plus the ten newest active rows with Forget buttons and the footer, /permissions all lists every active record short-id first, /permissions forget <prefix> resolves one/ambiguous/none, a Forget tap edits the list in place and confirms on every provider (Discord acknowledges first), group variants reply the DM guidance without mutating, and the used-by suffix appears only from actual job consumption. No live provider was available to the checker; the harness drives the same handlers the providers bind.
scenarios: DM: remember an Allow on a card, send /permissions → mode line + one row 'Allow · <scope> · <place> · <d Mon> · <label>' with a Forget button; /permissions all → the same row with its short id first
Forget tap → 'Forgot: <scope>. I'll ask next time.' and the row is removed from the edited list; a second tap on the stale message → 'Already forgotten.'
/permissions forget <4-char prefix> on a fresh record → Forgot; an ambiguous prefix → the ambiguity reply with nothing mutated; unknown → the not-found reply
job projection: the remembered call runs a scheduled job with zero cards, the row gains '· used by job <name>'; after Forget the same job asks again (S5)
group route: /permissions, /permissions all, /permissions forget abcd → mode line + 'Remembered decisions are a DM feature…', zero service writes
provider edit failure: the Forget receipt is still sent on Telegram, Slack, Discord and Teams
old-rails rows: neither listed nor revocable; empty state: 'Nothing remembered yet. Tap Allow on a card and it shows up here.'
residual_risks: Live tap-through on a real provider deferred to the post-merge runtime redeploy (Ravi's go-ahead required for a restart).
